caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher rendered in gray pencil on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher has a wide, flaring spout on the left and a rounded, ornate handle on the right. The body of the pitcher features intricate decorative patterns including vertical ridges on the upper half and swirling, leaf-like motifs around the lower half. The bottom edge of the pitcher is adorned with a row of rounded, bead-like shapes. The overall form is rounded and slightly flares outward toward the top, while the ornamentation is detailed and emphasized with shading. There is a simple rectangular border framing the drawing on the page. In the lower right corner, the name "H. FORNAGALLI" is inscribed.
title: Blown Glass - Pitcher
